page: Microsoft Azure M48bs_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MBSMediumMemoryv3 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 24 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8473C processor operating at 4.0 GHz. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, but it is premium storage capable and optimized for block storage performance.

In benchmark testing, the M48bs_v3 demonstrates strong memory bandwidth, scoring in the top 25% for both cached small-block reads and uncached large-block read/write operations. Single-core performance is highly competitive, with Geekbench single-core, image processing, and text processing scores reaching the top 10% tier. Multi-core capabilities are also robust, as evidenced by top 25% results in Passmark CPU tests, software compilation, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. For LLM inference, the server achieves strong performance in text generation for 135M and 7B models, while maintaining average speeds for larger 70B models.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and dedicated Intel Xeon processor, the M48bs_v3 offers high resource density for memory-bound workloads without the overhead of local storage. This hardware profile is well-suited for enterprise database operations, memory-intensive data processing, static web serving, and medium-scale language model inference.
